Google.Cloud.Support.V2Beta version 1.0.0-beta01

  • Initial generation for Google.Cloud.Support.V2Beta

Google.Cloud.TextToSpeech.V1 version 3.12.0

New features

  • Support pinyin/yomigana custom pronunciation encodings for cmn-cn/ja-jp
